clamp: Assembled club, butt end clamped, head plucked; the cpm calibration uses a 5 in (0.127 m) butt clamp.

sources.flex_cpm: Mid-range of two independent driver tables at 44-45.5 in. Hireko Golf, Modern Guide to Shaft Fitting ch. 4 and Dynamic Shaft Fitting Index (graphite driver means A 234, R 246, S 258, X 271 cpm; A-X at 45 in, D-1 swingweight, butt-clamped assembled club; https://www.hirekogolf.com/pub/media/Modern_Guide_to_Shaft_Fitting_chapter4.pdf and https://www.slideshare.net/raltomonte/the-hireko-golf-dynamic-shaft-fitting-index). Steadfast Golf, replacement driver shaft chart at 45.5 in (A 227, R 241, S 258, X 273 cpm; clamp not stated; https://steadfastgolf.com/blogs/shaft-insights/best-replacement-golf-shafts-for-drivers-and-fairway-woods). Ladies is the Hireko L mean (229 cpm at ladies length 44 in, C-6) moved to 45 in with the length slope: 229 - 9.3 = 219.7, rounded to 220.
sources.length_slope_cpm_per_in: About 8.6 cpm per inch (4.3 cpm per half inch; Braly, iron shafts, 7 in clamp, 261 g head, https://www.golfshaftreviews.info/understand-golf-shaft-stiffness-ratings/) to about 10 cpm per inch (same head weight and tip trim; https://www.tutelman.com/golf/shafts/frequency.php). The 9.3 cpm per inch value is the midpoint. A longer club reads softer.
sources.reference_club_length_in: Hireko tested A-X at 45 in; Steadfast tabulates its driver column at 45.5 in, within the slope's half-inch (about 5 cpm) and inside the 10 cpm test tolerance.
